name: Vala (Meson)
cmd_system: meson setup build && meson compile -C build

name: C++ (Meson)
cmd_system: meson setup build && meson compile -C build

name: FiveM/RedM Script
cmd_system: mkdir -p dist && cp -r . dist/ 2>/dev/null; echo 'Script ready'

name: Godot Game
cmd_system: godot --headless --export-release 'Linux/X11' 2>/dev/null || echo 'Export preset not configured; use Godot editor'

runtime_deps.apt: php php-cli php-xml php-mbstring php-curl php-mysql
runtime_deps.dnf: php php-cli php-xml php-mbstring php-curl php-mysqlnd

name: Dart (pub)
cmd_system: dart pub get && dart compile exe bin/main.dart -o build/main

name: Fortran (CMake / Make)
cmd_system: mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make -j$(nproc)
